global.title: Auto start/stop defaults
global.description: Defaults applied to every eligible thermostat that has no dedicated instance.

thermostat.title: Thermostat
thermostat.description: Select the thermostat that gets its own auto start/stop configuration.

thermostat_options.title: Thermostat settings
thermostat_options.description: Values of this thermostat. Fields left at the default inherit the global instance.

exclusion.title: Exclude a thermostat
exclusion.description: The thermostat will not use the auto start/stop feature at all, exactly as if it had never been enabled. The core feature is cleared for it.

menu.title: What do you want to configure?

error.not_over_climate: This thermostat is not an over_climate thermostat, so the auto start/stop cannot be applied to it.
error.valve_regulation: This thermostat is regulated by a valve, which the auto start/stop feature does not support.
error.invalid_entity: The selected thermostat no longer exists.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat already has an auto start/stop configuration.
abort.exclusion_not_configurable: An exclusion carries no parameter. Remove it and configure the thermostat instead.
